Then use it with bone meal to restore bare ground within %s blocks: exposed dirt regains its cover, bare grass gets its biome's plants and, with saplings in your offhand, native trees return (one sapling and %s bone meal each). Builds, containers and claims are left alone.

entrelumen.exploration.chart.no_data: This map has no chart data on this server. Nothing changed.

Its blank pixels are drawn from your other maps of the same area and dimension, at the same or a finer scale. To gather several maps into one, first zoom a map out at a cartography table. Explored pixels never change, and nothing is consumed.
